theorem compact_inverse_jet_bound [ProperSpace E] (hU : IsOpen U)
    (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ p ∈ K,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun q => (D.matrix q)⁻¹) p‖ ≤ C
